subject: Contract lane synchronization — proposed windows + evidence ask
content:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@crestline.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Contract lane synchronization — proposed windows + evidence ask

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo and the follow-up last week. Legal at Crestline asked that we lock in a short redline walk-through (30–45m) focused on two items: the latest MSA edits and the evidence bundle for our security review. We have a couple of constraints: EMEA legal wants a presence on the call and procurement needs the DocuSign readiness confirmed.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue Oct 20 — 9:30–10:15 or 11:00–11:45
- Wed Oct 21 — 8:00–8:45 (EMEA-friendly morning)

Can you confirm which slot works for Redwood and whether you can provide: the vendor-facing redline PDF and a one-sheet evidence inventory (S3 locations or zipped bundle)? If you can attach the redline in advance we can triage internally and come with line notes.

Also: any preference on who from Redwood leads the walk-through? Our Legal Ops will be on the call; I copied them so they have the times.

Thanks,
Alicia Moreno
Head of Vendor Programs
Crestline Therapeutics

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@crestline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 17:10:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract lane synchronization — proposed windows + evidence ask

Hi Alicia — great to hear from you and thanks for laying out the constraints. We can do the Tue Oct 20 11:00–11:45 PDT slot; that lets us include our infra lead and still accommodate EMEA participants if they dial in slightly later. Ben and Neha are looped to gather and confirm the evidence artifacts.

I'll lead the redline walk-through and Ben will cover the evidence inventory and SSO/retention items. Neha will coordinate the DocuSign readiness (routing, signer roles).

We have a working redline (v3) ready to share. For the call prep I can attach: redline_MSA_v3.pdf and a compact evidence inventory (CSV) that lists logs, SOC artifacts, and access points. I will share the DocuSign link once Neha confirms signer mapping.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
1) 5m introductions / scope
2) 20m redline walk (calls out any showstoppers)
3) 10m evidence inventory + next steps
4) 5m DocuSign / timeline check

If that works I’ll send calendar invite with the attachments and a read-only Drive link for the evidence bundle.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: redline_MSA_v3.pdf (3.2 MB), evidence_inventory.csv (12 KB)

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract lane synchronization — proposed windows + evidence ask

Vanessa / Neha — quick internal note: I’ll assemble a trimmed evidence bundle (logs, SOC2 summary, single-sign-on checklist) and upload to a shared Drive folder by EOD Mon (link to follow). Neha — can you confirm if we should add the Crestline legal group as signers in DocuSign or route through their procurement contact? I’ll also prepare a 1-page appendix for the redline showing recommended concessions vs optional edits.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise CS Ops
Redwood Inference

---

From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@crestline.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal-ops@crestline.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 13:20:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract lane synchronization — proposed windows + evidence ask

Thanks — the Tuesday 11:00 slot should be fine but a couple of our EMEA stakeholders asked for a 10:30 start instead (they can join at 11:00 but prefer sooner). Is there any flexibility to start at 10:30 PDT? If not, we’ll stick with 11:00.

Also we requested redline in PDF and Word formats so comments are easier to import. If you can provide a Word doc of the MSA redline that would be ideal.

We’ve also attached our internal doc request (see attached: crestline_evidence_request.pdf) — it’s high level but flags encryption at rest, retention, and incident response items up front.

Alicia

Attachment stub: crestline_evidence_request.pdf (45 KB)

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@crestline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract lane synchronization — proposed windows + evidence ask

Alicia — thanks for the heads up. We can shift the start to 10:30 PDT to accommodate EMEA. Calendar invite updated.

Attachments included for prep: redline_MSA_v3.pdf, redline_MSA_v3.docx, evidence_inventory.csv, onboarding-checklist.pdf
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/crestline/MSA-DL-2026-0789 (routing set to: Crestline Legal -> Crestline Procurement -> Redwood Legal)

Final agenda will be the same; Ben will screen-share the evidence inventory and I’ll do the redline walk-through. Neha confirmed signer mapping and will be on the bridge to handle any DocuSign questions.

Looking forward to the sync — invite shows 10:30–11:15 PDT on Tue Oct 20.

Best,
Vanessa
